categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of test and measurement instruments and meters. Its main product lines include general instruments, professional instruments, temperature and environmental test instruments, and test instruments. These products serve diverse applications in electronics, household appliances, electromechanical equipment, energy conservation, rail transit, automotive manufacturing, new energy, IoT, AI, power construction and maintenance, higher education, and scientific research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as high-efficiency sampling and digital signal processing, automatic calibration, stable and rapid voltage boosting, step voltage setting, linear signal processing, sensor application and signal processing, image processing, and 3D waveform real-time display. It has developed key components like ADC chips for oscilloscopes and employs advanced manufacturing execution systems (MES) and product lifecycle management (PLM) to optimize production. The company also focuses on AI-enhanced infrared imaging algorithms and high-precision measurement technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international distributors, OEM/ODM clients mainly in Europe and America, and end-users in industries such as power, new energy, telecommunications, automotive electronics, aerospace, education, and scientific research institutions. The company also serves major listed companies, central enterprises, state-owned enterprises, universities, and research institutes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Dongguan and Heyuan, and has established subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Germany, the United States, and Vietnam. Its products are sold in over 80 countries and regions worldwide, with significant markets in Europe, America, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of test and measurement instruments. It procures key raw materials such as ICs, PCBs, LCDs, resistors, capacitors, and components from multiple suppliers and maintains a stable supplier management system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on market-driven R&D with increased investment in high-end and specialized instruments such as power and new energy meters, high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, source-load instruments, and electronic component testers. It aims to achieve core component self-control, enhance product high-endization and intelligence, and expand global marketing and production capabilities. The company also emphasizes AI and image processing technologies in infrared thermal imaging products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of test and measurement instruments under its own brand and ODM services for international clients. Sales channels include domestic and international distributors, direct sales to end customers, e-commerce platforms, and ODM contracts. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders such as Fluke and Keysight Technologies in the test and measurement industry. It positions itself as a leading domestic brand with comprehensive product lines covering oscilloscopes, signal sources, RF instruments, power supplies, and specialized meters. It holds a technology leadership position domestically with a growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.02 billion, a 14.44% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161.39 million, up 37.46%. Total assets reached RMB 1.44 billion, growing 18.32%. R&D investment accounted for 10.17% of revenue, reflecting a 45% increase in R&D spending. The company maintains strong cash flow and has a stable and growing shareholder base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-safety, high-reliability, and cost-effective test and measurement products with advanced proprietary technologies. Its product differentiation lies in comprehensive product categories, high precision, innovative features such as AI-enhanced imaging, rapid voltage boosting, and specialized instruments for emerging industries like new energy and photovoltaics. It offers integrated solutions with strong after-sales service and global marketing networks.
